description: An expander adding eight more merge inputs to SMMix, numbered IN 9 to IN 16; it goes immediately to the left of SMMix

inputs.text: A signal merged into the POLY output of SMMix at the channel matching its number; it arrives there at one tenth of the voltage patched in, and no crossfade knob acts on it

notes: nothing happens unless SMMix is the module immediately to the right; the ACTIVE lamp is lit while it is, and dark while it is not
